Craig Jones - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: Craig Jones' B-Team passing system (now sold as 'The B Team Top Game'), six volumes, organised around three types of bottom player. Volume 1 redefines the bottom position, covers removing the guard and forcing errors. Volume 2 covers supine guards (approaching, stripping grips, the 'dirty feet' drill). Volume 3 covers 'pocket passing' (front pommel, pressure from standing north-south, combining pummelling and toreando). Volume 4 covers seated guards (approaching, forcing them supine, the knee cut). Volume 5 covers shin-on-shin (early and late stage) and forcing sit-up guard. Volume 6 covers people trying to stand up (head over head, addressing frames, controlling the feet).
Craig Jones - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: No-gi passers facing modern seated and supine guards.

Craig Jones - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: Craig Jones' B-Team bottom game (now sold as 'The B Team Bottom Game'), six volumes, built on getting up rather than playing guard for its own sake. Volume 1 covers his principles ('if you can get up, get up; if you can shoot, shoot'). Volume 2 covers the inside knee pull trilemma, single legs and leg attacks. Volume 3 covers mid-range play (shoulder line, the fundamental heist). Volume 4 covers reverse Z guard (dealing with the claw, heisting up). Volume 5 covers rethinking the turtle (offensive grips, vulnerabilities of the seatbelt). Volume 6 covers 4-point (shaking people off, switching).
Craig Jones - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: No-gi players who want to wrestle up from bottom rather than play a passive guard.

Craig Jones - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: Craig Jones and nutritionist Jordan Sullivan on diet and weight management for grapplers and fighters, three parts (about 4 hours). It covers nutrition fundamentals for combat athletes, eating around training, making weight safely and weight cutting. No publisher listing was found.
Craig Jones - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: Competitors who need to make weight, or anyone wanting better nutrition around training.
